name: Pumpkin Farmer Quality
description:
A 3x3 patch for breeding high-quality pumpkin: each run harvests it, keeps the best in the seed container and replants from it.

Bots:
• Pumpkin Farmer Quality

In each area:
• Crop Quality(Pumpkin): till the soil (nothing to build)
• Seeds of crop quality(Pumpkin): exactly one chest or crate; the best seeds and crops are kept in it (the bot stops without one)
• Pumpkin Flesh: nothing to build: the bot piles Pumpkin Flesh here (or put a container in it)

Also needed:
• The Quality grid size option set to "3x3" (Options > Farming).
• Optional: the Seed Trough preset, used when "Keep quality grind containers at most half full" is on.
